decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plan numbered 10/NB/002 submitted on the 14th March 2011 and the plan numbered 10/NB/001 Rev.A submitted on the 3rd May 2011 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The block paving shall be of a permeable construction or all rainwater shall be directed to a lawn or border to drain naturally to a permeable area within the site.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, conversion of garage to create habitable accommodation and block paving to front garden
